G0630.def:
**ἀπο-λύω **
[in LXX for שׁוּב, etc., frequently in 1-4 Mac ;]
1. **to set free, release**: [[Luk.13.12|Luk.13:12]], [[Jhn.19.10|Jhn.19:10]], al.; a debtor, [[Mat.18.27|Mat.18:27]] metaphorically, of forgive­ness, [[Luk.6.37|Luk.6:37]]
2. **to let go, dismiss **(Field, _Notes_, 9 f.): [[Mat.15.23|Mat.15:23]], [[Luk.2.29; 9.12|Luk.2:29 9:12]], [[Act.19.41|Act.19:41]], al.; of divorce, τ. γυναῖκα: [[Mat.1.19; 5.31-32; 19.3, 8; 19.10|Mat.1:19 5:31-32 19:3, 8 19:10]] [[Mrk.10.2, 4; 10.11|Mrk.10:2, 4 10:11]], [[Luk.16.18|Luk.16:18]]; with ref. to Gk. and Rom. (net Jewish) custom, τ. ἄνδρα: [[Mrk.10.12|Mrk.10:12]] Mid., **to depart**: [[Act.28.25|Act.28:25]] (MM, see word)
(AS)

G0611.def:
**ἀποκρίνω**, **ἀποκρίνομαι**,
[in LXX chiefly for ענה ;]
in cl.,
1. **to separate, distinguish**.
2. **to choose**.
Mid., **to answer**: [[Mat.27.12|Mat.27:12]], [[Mrk.14.61|Mrk.14:61]], [[Luk.3.16; 23.9|Luk.3:16 23:9]], [[Jhn.5.17, 19|Jhn.5:17, 19]] [[Act.3.12|Act.3:12]]. In late Gk. the pass, also is used in this sense, and pass. forms are the more frequently in NT (M, _Pr._, 39, 161; MM, see word);
(a) **in general sense**: absol., [[Mrk.12.34|Mrk.12:34]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.22.46|Mat.22:46]] with dative of person(s), [[Mat.12.38|Mat.12:38]] before πρός, [[Act.25.16|Act.25:16]]
(b) Hebraistically
(i) like ענה, **to begin to speak, take up the conversation** (Kennedy, _Sources_, 124f.): [[Mat.11.25|Mat.11:25]], al.,
(ii) redundant, as in the Heb. phrase וַיַּעַן וַיּאֹמֶר (Dalman, _Words_, 24f., 38; M, _Pr._, 14; Bl., §58, 4; 74, 2; Cremer, 374): ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπε, [[Mat.4.4|Mat.4:4]] ἔφη, 8:8; λέγει, [[Mrk.3.33|Mrk.3:33]] in Jo most frequently (ἀπεκ. κ. εἶπε, 1:49. )
(AS)

G0647.def:
**ἀποστάσιον**, -ου, τό
(ἀφίστημι), [in LXX; [[Deu.24.1|Deu.24:1]], 3, [[Jer.3.8|Jer.3:8]], [[Isa.50.1|Isa.50:1]] (כְּרִיתוּת) * ;]
1. in cl., only in phrase ἀποστασίου δίκη, an action against a freedman for forsaking his προστάτης (Dem.).
2. **In LXX, βιβλίον ἀποστασίου, a bill of divorce**: [[Mat.19.7|Mat.19:7]], [[Mrk.10.4|Mrk.10:4]]; in same sense ἀ. alone (MM, see word), [[Mat.5.31|Mat.5:31]] (for other late exx., see MM, l.with; Kennedy, _Sources_, 121).†
(AS)

G0620.def:
**ἀπο-λείπω **
[in LXX for H2308 יָתַר, etc. ;]
1. **to leave, leave behind **(in π. a term. techn. in wills; see MM, see word): [[2Ti.4.13; 4.20|2Ti.4:13 4:20]], [[Tit.1.5|Tit.1:5]]; pass., **to be reserved, remain**: [[Heb.4.6, 9; 10.26|Heb.4:6, 9 10:26]].
2. **to desert, abandon**: [[Jude.6|Ju 6]].†
(AS)

G0654.def:
**ἀπο-στρέφω **
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;]
trans., with accusative,
(a) **to turn away, remove**: [[Rom.11.26|Rom.11:26]], [[2Ti.4.4|2Ti.4:4]]; metaphorically, **to turn away from allegiance, pervert**: [[Luk.23.14|Luk.23:14]]
(b) **to turn back, return**: μάχαιραν, [[Mat.26.52|Mat.26:52]] Pass., reflex., **to turn oneself away from**: with accusative, [[Mat.5.42|Mat.5:42]], [[2Ti.1.15|2Ti.1:15]], [[Tit.1.14|Tit.1:14]], [[Heb.12.25|Heb.12:25]]; so act., absol., [[Act.3.26|Act.3:26]] (cf. [[Sir.8.5|Sir.8:5]] Bl., § 53, 1; Cremer, 880).†
(AS)

G0684.def:
**ἀπώλεια**, -ας, ἡ
(ἀπόλλυμι), [in LXX (Cremer, 797) for אָבַד, אֵיד, etc. ;]
**destruction, waste, loss, perishing **(in π., of money, see MM, see word): [[Mat.26.8|Mat.26:8]], [[Mrk.14.4|Mrk.14:4]], [[Act.8.20|Act.8:20]], [[Rom.9.22|Rom.9:22]], [[1Ti.6.9|1Ti.6:9]], [[2Pe.2.1|2Pe.2:1]]; in special sense of the loss of eternal life, perdition, the antithesis of σωτηρία: [[Mat.7.13|Mat.7:13]], [[Jhn.17.12|Jhn.17:12]], [[Php.1.28; 3.19|Php.1:28 3:19]], [[2Th.2.3|2Th.2:3]], [[Heb.10.39|Heb.10:39]], [[2Pe.2.3; 3.7; 3.16|2Pe.2:3 3:7 3:16]], [[Rev.17.8, 11|Rev.17:8, 11]] (_DB_, iii, 744).†
(AS)

G0686.def:
**ἄρα**,
_illative particle_, expressing a more subjective or informal inference than οὖν,
**then**: prop. (as in cl.), the second word in the sentence, [[Rom.7.21; 8.1|Rom.7:21 8:1]], [[Gal.3.7|Gal.3:7]]; ἐπεὶ ἄρα, [[1Co.7.14|1Co.7:14]] (with another word between) 5:10; as the first word, [[Luk.11.48|Luk.11:48]], [[Act.11.18|Act.11:18]], [[Rom.10.17|Rom.10:17]], [[1Co.15.18|1Co.15:18]], [[2Co.5.15; 7.12|2Co.5:15 7:12]], [[Heb.4.9|Heb.4:9]]; so prop. in apodosis after protasis with εἰ, [[Mat.12.28|Mat.12:28]], [[Luk.11.20|Luk.11:20]], [[Gal.2.21; 3.29; 5.11|Gal.2:21 3:29 5:11]], [[Heb.12.8|Heb.12:8]] (κενὸν ἄρα), [[1Co.15.14|1Co.15:14]] often in interrogations, direct and indirect, τίς (τί) ἄρα, [[Mat.18.1; 19.25, 27; 24.45|Mat.18:1 19:25, 27 24:45]], [[Mrk.4.41|Mrk.4:41]], [[Luk.1.66; 8.25; 12.42; 22.23|Luk.1:66 8:25 12:42 22:23]], [[Act.12.18|Act.12:18]]; εἰ ἄρα, [[Mrk.11.13|Mrk.11:13]], [[Act.8.22|Act.8:22]]; εἴπερ ἄρα, [[1Co.15.15|1Co.15:15]] οὐκ ἄρα, [[Act.21.38|Act.21:38]] μήτι ἄρα, [[2Co.1.17|2Co.1:17]] in strengthened forms, ἄρα γε, ἄραγε, [[Mat.7.20; 17.26|Mat.7:20 17:26]], [[Act.17.27|Act.17:27]], and more frequently ἄρα οὖν (Epp. Paul.), **so then**, [[Rom.5.18; 7.3, 25; 8.12; 9.16, 18; 14.19|Rom.5:18 7:3, 25 8:12 9:16, 18 14:19]], [[Gal.6.10|Gal.6:10]], [[Eph.2.19|Eph.2:19]], [[1Th.5.6|1Th.5:6]], [[2Th.2.15|2Th.2:15]] (Bl., §77, 2; 78, 5; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0681.def:
**ἅπτω **
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַע ;]
prop., to fasten to; hence, of fire, **to kindle, light**: [[Luk.8.16; 11.33; 15.8|Luk.8:16 11:33 15:8]], [[Act.28.2|Act.28:2]]. Mid., with genitive, to fasten oneself to, cling to, lay hold of (so in π.; MM, see word): [[Mat.8.3, 15|Mat.8:3, 15]], [[Jhn.20.17|Jhn.20:17]], al.; of carnal intercourse, [[1Co.7.1|1Co.7:1]] with reference to levitical and ceremonial prohibitions, [[2Co.6.17|2Co.6:17]], [[Col.2.21|Col.2:21]]; of hostile action, [[1Jn.5.18|1Jn.5:18]] (cf. ἀν-, καθ-, περι- άπτω)
_SYN._: θιγγάνω, ψηλαφάω. ἅ. is the stronger, θ., to touch, the lighter term. ψ. is to feel, as in search of something (Tr., _Syn._, § xvii; Lft., Col., 201 f.) (AS)

G0652.def:
**ἀπόστολος**, -ου, ὁ
(ἀοστέλλω), [in LXX; [[1Ki.14.6|3Ki.14:6]] A (שָׁלַח) * ;]
1. a fleet, an expedition (Dem.).
2. a messenger, one sent on a mission (Hdt., LXX, l.with, and π.; see M, _Pr._, 37 f.; MM, see word; M, _Th._, i, 2:7 and reff.): [[Jhn.13.16|Jhn.13:16]], [[2Co.8.23|2Co.8:23]] [[Php.2.25|Php.2:25]].
3. In NT, an Apostle of Christ
(a) with special ref. to the Twelve: [[Mat.10.2|Mat.10:2]], [[Mrk.3.14|Mrk.3:14]], [[Luk.11.49|Luk.11:49]], [[Eph.3.5|Eph.3:5]], [[Rev.18.20|Rev.18:20]], al., equality with whom is claimed by St. Paul, [[Gal.1.1, 11|Gal.1:1, 11]] ff, [[1Ti.2.7|1Ti.2:7]], a1.;
(b) in a wider sense of prominent Christian teachers, as Barnabas, [[Act.14.14|Act.14:14]], apparently also Silvanus and Timothy, [[1Th.2.6|1Th.2:6]], and perhaps Andronicus and Junias (Junia?), [[Rom.16.7|Rom.16:7]] (see _ICC_, in l); of false teachers, **claiming apostleship**: [[2Co.11.5; 11.13|2Co.11:5 11:13]], [[Rev.2.2|Rev.2:2]]. (On the different uses of the term in NT, see Lit., _Gal._, 92-101; Cremer, 530; _DB_, i, 126; _DCG_, i, 105; Enc. Br., ii, 196 ff.)
(AS)

G0696.def:
**ἄργυρος**, -ου, ὁ
(ἀργός, shining), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף ;]
**silver **(on its relation to ἀργύριον, see MM, see word): [[Mat.10.9|Mat.10:9]], [[Act.17.29|Act.17:29]], [[Jas.5.5|Jas.5:5]], [[Rev.18.12|Rev.18:12]].†
(AS)

G0615.def:
**ἀπο-κτείνω**
(also in late forms -κτέννω, [[Mat.10.28|Mat.10:28]], a1., LTTr., -κτεννύω, [[Mrk.12.5|Mrk.12:5]], WH), [in LXX for הָרַג, מוּת ;]
**to kill**: [[Mat.14.5|Mat.14:5]], al.; before instr. ἐν (which see), [[Eph.2.16|Eph.2:16]], [[Rev.2.23|Rev.2:23]], al. Metaphorical: [[Rom.7.11|Rom.7:11]] τ. ἔχθραν, [[Eph.2.16|Eph.2:16]] τὸ γράμμα ἀποκτείνει [[2Co.3.6|2Co.3:6]] (on the perfective force of this verb, see M, _Pr._, 114)
(AS)

G0600.def:
**ἀπο-καθ-ίστημι** (ἀποκαθιστάω, [[Mrk.9.12|Mrk.9:12]], Rec., -ιστάνω, LTTr.; cf. [[Act.1.6|Act.1:6]] -κατιστάνω, WH),
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;]
1. to restore, i.e. to a former condition: of health, [[Mat.12.13|Mat.12:13]], [[Mrk.3.5; 8.25|Mrk.3:5 8:25]], [[Luk.6.10|Luk.6:10]]; of social or political affairs, [[Mat.17.11|Mat.17:11]], [[Mrk.9.12|Mrk.9:12]], [[Act.1.6|Act.1:6]].
2. **to give back, bring back**: [[Heb.13.19|Heb.13:19]] (so in π., MM, see word; cf. also Cremer, 312).†
(AS)

G0692.def:
**ἀργός**, -όν
(in late Gk., incl. NT, -ή, -όν; ἀ- neg., ἔργον) [in LXX: [[1Ki.6.7|3Ki.6:7]] (מַסָּע), [[Wis.14.5; 15.15|Wis.14:5 15:15]], [[Sir.37.11; 38.28|Sir.37:11 38:28]] * ;]
**inactive, idle**: [[Mat.20.3|Mat.20:3]], 6, [[1Ti.5.13|1Ti.5:13]], [[Tit.1.12|Tit.1:12]], [[2Pe.1.8|2Pe.1:8]]. Metaphorical, of things, **inactive, ineffective, worthless**: ῥῆμα, [[Mat.12.36|Mat.12:36]] πίστις, [[Jas.2.20|Jas.2:20]] (see Cremer, 259 f.).†
_SYN._: βραδύς, slow; νωθρός, sluggish (Tr., _Syn._, § civ) (AS)

G0659.def:
**ἀπο-τίθημι **
[in LXX chiefly for נוּחַ hi. ;]
**to put off or aside**; in NT always mid.,
(a) **to put of from oneself as a garment**: τ. ἱμάτια, [[Act.7.58|Act.7:58]] metaphorically, in ethical sense, **to put of, lay aside**: [[Rom.13.12|Rom.13:12]], [[Eph.4.22, 25|Eph.4:22, 25]], [[Col.3.8|Col.3:8]], [[Heb.12.1|Heb.12:1]], [[Jas.1.21|Jas.1:21]], [[1Pe.2.1|1Pe.2:1]];
(b) **to stow away, put**: ἐν τ. φυλακῇ (MM, see word), [[Mat.14.3|Mat.14:3]]†
(AS)

G0694.def:
**ἀργύριον**, -ου, τό
(ἄργυρος), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף ([[Gen.13.2|Gen.13:2]], al.), exc. [[Lam.4.1|La 4:1]] (כֶּתֶם) ;]
prop., a piece of silver (Lft., _Notes_, 191); in NT,
(a) **silver**: [[Act.3.6; 7.16; 19.19; 20.33|Act.3:6 7:16 19:19 20:33]], [[1Co.3.12|1Co.3:12]], [[1Pe.1.18|1Pe.1:18]];
(b) **money**: [[Mat.25.18, 27|Mat.25:18, 27]], [[Mrk.14.11|Mrk.14:11]], [[Luk.9.3; 19.15, 23; 22.5|Luk.9:3 19:15, 23 22:5]], [[Act.8.20|Act.8:20]];
(with) **a silver coin**: p1., [[Mat.26.15; 27.3-6, 9; 28.12, 15|Mat.26:15 27:3-6, 9 28:12, 15]], where the value is that of a shekel or tetradrachm; ἀργυρίου μυριάδες πέντε (prob. drachmas; MM, see word), [[Act.19.19|Act.19:19]]†
(AS)

G0645.def:
**ἀπο-σπάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָתַק: ni., hi., etc. ;]
**to draw off or away, tear away **(MM, see word): [[Act.20.30|Act.20:30]] μάχαιραν, draw a sword, [[Mat.26.51|Mat.26:51]] pass., to be parted or withdrawn (Field, _Notes_, 134; but see Thayer, see word), [[Luk.22.41|Luk.22:41]], [[Act.21.1|Act.21:1]].†
(AS)

G0633.def:
**ἀπο-νίπτω **
[in LXX for שָׁטַף, רָחַץ, מָחָה ;]
**to wash off**: mid. (reflex.), τ. χεῖρας, [[Mat.27.24|Mat.27:24]]†
(AS)

G0614.def:
**ἀπόκρυφος**, -ον
(ἀποκρύπτω), [in LXX Chiefly for סֵתֶר ;]
**hidden**: [[Mrk.4.22|Mrk.4:22]], [[Luk.8.17|Luk.8:17]], [[Col.2.3|Col.2:3]] (see Lft., in l; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0639.def:
**ἀπορέω**, -ῶ
(ἄπορος, ἀ- neg., πόρος, a way, resource), [in LXX for צָרַר, מוּךְ, etc. ;]
**to be at a loss, be perplexed**: absol., [[Mrk.6.20|Mrk.6:20]] (ἐποίει, R, mg.); mid., **be in doubt**: absol., [[2Co.4.8|2Co.4:8]] with accusative, [[Act.25.20|Act.25:20]] before περί, [[Luk.24.4|Luk.24:4]] ἐν, [[Gal.4.20|Gal.4:20]] περὶ τίνος λέγει, [[Jhn.13.22|Jhn.13:22]]†
_SYN._: διαπορέω, διακρίνομαι, διστάζω, μετεωρίζομαι (see _DCG_, i, 491) (AS)

G0618.def:
**ἀπο-λαμβάνω **
[in LXX: [[Num.34.14|Num.34:14]] (לָקַח ([[Deu.25.5|Deu.25:5]] A, [[Isa.5.17|Isa.5:17]], [[2Ma.4.46|2Ma.4:46]] [[2Mac.6.21|2Mac 6:21]] [[2Mac.8.6|2Mac 8:6]], [[4Ma.18.23|4Ma.18:23]] * ;]
1. **to receive from another**; absol., **to receive as one's due**: [[Luk.16.25; 18.30|Luk.16:25 18:30]] (seel. λάβῃ) [[Luk.23.41|Luk.23:41]], [[Rom.1.27|Rom.1:27]], [[Gal.4.5|Gal.4:5]], [[Col.3.24|Col.3:24]], [[2Jn.8|2Jn.8]].
2. **to receive back**: [[Luk.6.34; 15.27|Luk.6:34 15:27]].
3. **to take apart or aside**: [[Mrk.7.33|Mrk.7:33]] (cf. use in π. of the recluses of the Serapeum; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0609.def:
**ἀπο-κόπτω **
[in LXX for קָצַץ, כָּרַת, etc. ;]
**to cut off**: [[Mrk.9.43, 45|Mrk.9:43, 45]], [[Jhn.18.10, 26|Jhn.18:10, 26]] [[Act.27.32|Act.27:32]]. Mid., **to mutilate oneself, have oneself mutilated**: [[Gal.5.12|Gal.5:12]] (cf. [[Deu.23.1|Deu.23:1]] LXX; and see Cremer, 751; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0650.def:
**ἀπο-στερέω**, -ῶ
(στερέω, to rob), [in LXX: [[Exo.21.10|Exo.21:10]] (גָּרַע), [[Deu.24.14|Deu.24:14]] (עָשַׁק), [[Mal.3.5|Mal.3:5]], [[Sir.4.1; 29.6-7; 31.21-22|Sir.4:1 29:6-7 31:21-22]] * ;]
**to defraud, deprive of, despoil **(in cl. chiefly of the misappropriation of trust funds, Field, _Notes_, 33; cf. MM, see word): absol., [[Mrk.10.19|Mrk.10:19]], [[1Co.6.8|1Co.6:8]]; with accusative of person(s), [[1Co.7.5|1Co.7:5]] Mid., **endure deprivation**: [[1Co.6.7|1Co.6:7]] (WM, § 38, 3; but see Bl., § 54, 5; M, _Pr._, 162); pass., ἀπεστερημένοι, **bereft of**: [[1Ti.6.5|1Ti.6:5]]†
(AS)

G0635.def:
**ἀπο-πλανάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָדַח hi., נָטָה hi., שׁוּב pi. ;]
**to cause to go astray**; metaphorically, of leading into error: [[Mrk.13.22|Mrk.13:22]] pass., **to be led astray**: [[1Ti.6.10|1Ti.6:10]]†
(AS)

G0667.def:
**ἀπο-φέρω **
[in LXX for הָלַךְ, etc. ;]
**to carry off, bear, or lead away**: with accusative, [[Mrk.15.1|Mrk.15:1]], [[1Co.16.3|1Co.16:3]], [[Rev.17.3; 21.10|Rev.17:3 21:10]]. Pass., [[Luk.16.22|Luk.16:22]], [[Act.19.12|Act.19:12]].†
(AS)

G0602.def:
**ἀπο-κάλυψις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποκαλύπτω), [in LXX: [[1Sa.20.30|1Ki.20:30]] (עֶרְוָה), [[Sir.11.27; 22.22; 42.1|Sir.11:27 22:22 42:1]] * ;]
an uncovering, laying bare (Plut.). Metaphorical, **a reveal­ing, revelation**: a disclosure of divine truth, or **a manifestion from God**: [[Luk.2.32|Luk.2:32]] [[Rom.2.5; 8.19; 16.25|Rom.2:5 8:19 16:25]], [[1Co.1.7; 14.6; 14.26|1Co.1:7 14:6 14:26]], [[2Co.12.1; 12.7|2Co.12:1 12:7]], [[Gal.1.12; 2.2|Gal.1:12 2:2]], [[Eph.1.17; 3.3|Eph.1:17 3:3]] [[2Th.1.7|2Th.1:7]] [[1Pe.1.7; 1.13; 4.13|1Pe.1:7 1:13 4:13]], [[Rev.1.1|Rev.1:1]].†
_SYN._: ἐπιφάνεια, παρουσία, φανέρωσις (see Tr., _Syn._, xciv; Lft., _Notes_, 102, 178; Westc, _Eph._, 178 f.; M, _Th._, 145 ff.; Cremer, 343) (AS)

G0612.def:
**ἀπό-κρισις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποκρίνομαι), [in LXX for דָּבָר, etc. ;]
**an answering, an answer**: [[Luk.2.47; 20.26|Luk.2:47 20:26]], [[Jhn.1.22; 19.9|Jhn.1:22 19:9]].†
(AS)

G0638.def:
**ἀπο-πνίγω **
[in LXX: [[Nam.2.13|Nam.2:13]] (חָנַק pi.), [[Tob.3.8|Tob.3:8]] * ;]
**to choke**: [[Mat.13.7|Mat.13:7]], [[Luk.8.7|Luk.8:7]]; pass., of drowning (= καταποντίζομαι), [[Luk.8.33|Luk.8:33]]†
(AS)

G0631.def:
**απο-μάσσω**
(μάσσω, Att... -ττω, to touch, handle), [in LXX: [[Tob.7.17|Tob.7:17]] * ;]
**to wipe off, wire clean**: mid., [[Luk.10.11|Luk.10:11]]†
(AS)

G0613.def:
**ἀπο-κρύπτω **
[in LXX chiefly for סָתַר ;]
**to hide, conceal, keep secret**: with accusative, [[Luk.10.21|Luk.10:21]] pass., [[1Co.2.7|1Co.2:7]], [[Eph.3.9|Eph.3:9]], [[Col.1.26|Col.1:26]] (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0653.def:
**ἀποστοματίζω**
(στόμα),
1. In cl., to speak from memory, to dic­tate to a pupil (Plat.).
2. In late Gk., **to catechize, question**: [[Luk.11.53|Luk.11:53]] (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0626.def:
**ἀπολογέομαι**, -οῦμαι
(ἀπό, λόγος), [in LXX: [[Jer.12.1|Jer.12:1]] (רִיב) [[Jer.31.6|Jer.31:6]], [[2Ma.13.26|2Ma.13:26]] * ;]
1. **to defend**: with accusative, [[Rom.2.15|Rom.2:15]]
2. **to defend one's self**: absol., [[Luk.21.14|Luk.21:14]], [[Act.26.1|Act.26:1]]; before ὅτι, [[Act.25.8|Act.25:8]] τί, to adduce something in one's defence, [[Luk.12.11|Luk.12:11]], [[Act.26.24|Act.26:24]] (ταῦτα) [[Act.24.10|Act.24:10]] (τὰ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ); περί, with genitive of thing(s), and ἐπί, with genitive of person(s), [[Act.26.2|Act.26:2]] with dative of person(s), [[Act.19.33|Act.19:33]], [[2Co.12.19|2Co.12:19]].†
(AS)

G0608.def:
**ἀπο-κλείω **
[in LXX chiefly for סָגַר ;]
**to shut fast**: [[Luk.13.25|Luk.13:25]]†
(AS)

G0658.def:
**ἀπο-τελέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: I [[Est.5.73|Est.5:73]], [[1Ma.15.39|1Ma.15:39]] * ;]
**to bring to an end, complete, accomplish **(cf. MM, see word): [[Luk.13.32|Luk.13:32]], [[Jas.1.15|Jas.1:15]].†
(AS)

G0621.def:
**ἀπο-λείχω**
(for ἐπιλ-, which see),
**to lick up**: [[Luk.16.21|Luk.16:21]], Rec.†
(AS)

G0687.def:
**ἆρα**,
_interrog. particle_,
implying anxiety or impatience, "quite rare and only in Luke and Paul, therefore a literary word" (Bl., §77, 2).
1. (num igitur) expecting a neg. reply, [[Luk.18.8|Luk.18:8]] ἆρά γε, [[Act.8.30|Act.8:30]]
2. (ergone) in apodosis, expecting an affirm. reply, [[Gal.2.17|Gal.2:17]] (Bl., l.with; Lft., _Ga._, in l.; MM, see word).
† (AS)

G0606.def:
**ἀπό-κειμαι **
[in LXX: [[Gen.49.10|Gen.49:10]] (שִׁילֹה), [[Job.38.23|Job.38:23]] (חָשַׂךְ), [[2Ma.12.45|2Ma.12:45]], [[4Ma.8.11|4Ma.8:11]] * ;]
**to be laid up, in store, laid away**: [[Luk.19.20|Luk.19:20]] Metaphorical, C. dative of person(s), **to be reserved **(Dem., Plat.; and see MM, see word): [[Col.1.5|Col.1:5]], [[2Ti.4.8|2Ti.4:8]], [[Heb.9.27|Heb.9:27]].†
(AS)

G0640.def:
**ἀπορία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἀπορέω), [in LXX for בֶּהָלָה, etc. ;]
**perplexity**: [[Luk.21.25|Luk.21:25]] (MM, see word; on the construction, see Field, _Notes_, 74 f.).†
(AS)

G0674.def:
**ἀπο-ψύχω **
[in LXX: [[4Ma.15.18|4Ma.15:18]] * ;]
1. to breathe out life, expire (Thue.; LXX, l.with).
2. **to leave off breathing, faint **(Hom., Od., xxiv, 348): before ἀπό, [[Luk.21.26|Luk.21:26]]†
(AS)

G0629.def:
**ἀπο-λύτρωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπολυτρόω, to release on payment of ransom, cf. λύτρον), [in LXX: Da (LXX) [[Dan.4.30|Dan.4:30]] with * ;]
**release effected by pay­ment of ransom, redemption, deliverance**; metaphorically, [[Heb.11.35|Heb.11:35]] of deliverance thr. Christ from evil and the consequences of sin: [[Luk.21.28|Luk.21:28]], [[Rom.3.24|Rom.3:24]] (Vau., in l) 8:23, [[1Co.1.30|1Co.1:30]], [[Eph.1.7, 14; 4.30|Eph.1:7, 14 4:30]], [[Col.1.14|Col.1:14]], [[Heb.9.15|Heb.9:15]]. (On the extent to WH. the word retains the sense of ransom, see _ICC_, [[Rom.3.24|Rom.3:24]], Westc., He., 297 ff.; see also _ICC_, _Eph._, 11; _DCG_, ii, 605; Cremer, 410; Deiss., _LAE_, 331; Lft., _Notes_, 271, 316; Tr., _Syn._, § 77.)†
(AS)

G0651.def:
**ἀπο-στολή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀποστέλλω), [in LXX: [[Deu.22.7|Deu.22:7]], [[1Ki.4.34; 9.16|3Ki.4:34 9:16]] [[Psa.78.49|Psa.78:49]], [[Ecc.8.8|Ecc.8:8]], [[Sng.4.13|Sng.4:13]] (for שָׁלַח and its cognates), [[1Es.9.51|1Es.9:51]] [[Est.9.54|Est.9:54]], [[Jer.32.36|Jer.32:36]], [[Bar.2.25|Bar.2:25]], [[1Ma.2.18|1Ma.2:18]], [[2Ma.3.2|2Ma.3:2]] *.]
1. In cl., a sending away (MM, see word), as, an expedition (Hdt.).
2. In LXX
(a) discharge, dis­missal ([[Ecc.8.8|Ecc.8:8]]);
(b) a gift ([[3Ki.9.16|3Ki.9:16]], [[1Ma.2.13|1Ma.2:13]]).
3. **In NT, the office of an Apostle of Christ, apostleship**: [[Act.1.25|Act.1:25]], [[Rom.1.5|Rom.1:5]], [[1Co.9.2|1Co.9:2]], [[Gal.2.8|Gal.2:8]] (Cremer, 530).†
(AS)

G0669.def:
**ἀπο-φθέγγομαι **
[in LXX for נָבָא, etc. ;]
**to speak forth, give utterance**: [[Act.2.4, 14; 26.25|Act.2:4, 14 26:25]] (MM, s. see).†
(AS)

G0605.def:
**ἀπο-κατά-στασις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποκαθίστημι),
**restoration**: [[Act.3.21|Act.3:21]] (in τ. of repairs and restorations of temples, see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0683.def:
**ἀπ-ωθέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for זָנַח, מָאַס, etc. ;]
to thrust away. Mid., **to thrust away from oneself, refuse, reject**: with accusative of person(s) (MM, see word), [[Act.7.27, 39; 13.46|Act.7:27, 39 13:46]], [[Rom.11.1-2|Rom.11:1-2]], [[1Ti.1.19|1Ti.1:19]].†
(AS)

G0634.def:
**ἀπο-πίπτω **
[in LXX for מָלַל, נָפַל, etc. ;]
**to fall off**: [[Act.9.18|Act.9:18]]†
(AS)

G0673.def:
**ἀπο-χωρίζω **
[in LXX: [[Ezk.43.21|Eze.43:21]] (מִפְקָד)* ;]
**to separate, part asunder**: pass., [[Rev.6.14|Rev.6:14]] reflexively, **to separate oneself**: [[Act.15.39|Act.15:39]]†
(AS)

G0697.def:
**Ἄρειος Πάυος** (T, Ἄριος Π.), -ου, ὁ
**Hill of Pres or Mars, Areopagus; also, the Court of Areopagus, the highest tribunal of Athens**: [[Act.17.19, 22|Act.17:19, 22]].†
(AS)

G0698.def:
**Ἀρεοπαγίτης** (T, -είτης), -ου, ὁ (see supr.),
**a judge of the Court of Areopagus**: [[Act.17.34|Act.17:34]]†
(AS)

G0695.def:
**ἀργυροκόπος**, -ου, ὁ
(ἄργυρος, κόπτω, to beat) [in LXX: [[Jdg.17.4|Jdg.17:4]], [[Jer.6.29|Jer.6:29]] (צָרַף) * ;]
**a silversmith**: [[Act.19.24|Act.19:24]] (Plut.; 77., see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0693.def:
**ἀργύρεος** (see MM, see word), -οῦς, -ᾶ, -οῦν
(ἄργυρος), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף ;]
**of silver**: [[Act.19.24|Act.19:24]] (WH, br.), [[2Ti.2.20|2Ti.2:20]], [[Rev.9.20|Rev.9:20]].†
(AS)

G0670.def:
**ἀπο-φορτίζομαι**
(φορτίζω, to load),
to discharge a cargo (Field, _Notes_, 134), **to unlade**: with accusative, τ. γόμον, [[Act.21.3|Act.21:3]]†
(AS)

G0643.def:
**ἀπο-σκευάζω **
[in LXX: [[Lev.14.36|Lev.14:36]] (פָּנָה pi.) * ;]
**to pack and carry off**; mid., **to pack and remove one's goods**: [[Act.21.15|Act.21:15]], Rec. (see ἐπισ-).†
ἐπι-σκευάζω,
[in LXX for pm pi., etc. ;]
**to equip, make ready**; mid., **to make one's preparations**: [[Act.21.15|Act.21:15]]†
(AS)

G0646.def:
**άποστασία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἀφίστημι), [in LXX for מַעַל, etc. ;]
**defection, apostasy, revolt**; in late Gk. (MM, _Exp._, viii; Lft., _Notes_, 111; Cremer, 308) for cl. ἀπόστασις, frequently in sense of political revolt, in LXX (e.g. [[Jos.22.22|Jos.22:22]], [[2Ch.29.19|2Ch.29:19]], [[Jer.2.19|Jer.2:19]]) and NT always of religious apostasy: [[Act.21.21|Act.21:21]], [[2Th.2.3|2Th.2:3]].†
(AS)

G0627.def:
**ἀπολογία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἀπολογέομαι), [in LXX: [[Wis.6.10|Wis.6:10]] * ;]
**a speech in defence**: [[Act.25.16|Act.25:16]], [[2Co.7.11|2Co.7:11]], [[Php.1.7, 16|Php.1:7, 16]], [[2Ti.4.16|2Ti.4:16]]; with dative of person(s), [[1Co.9.3|1Co.9:3]], [[1Pe.3.15|1Pe.3:15]]; before πρός, [[Act.22.1|Act.22:1]]†
(AS)

G0628.def:
**ἀπο-λούω **
[in LXX: [[Job.9.30|Job.9:30]] (רָחַץ)* ;]
**to wash off, wash away**; mid., metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), **to wash off oneself**: ἀμαρτίας, [[Act.22.16|Act.22:16]] absol., ἀπελούσασθε, ye washed yourselves clean (cf. Cremer, 406), [[1Co.6.11|1Co.6:11]]†
(AS)

G0677.def:
**ἀπρόσκοπος**, -ον
(προσκόπτω), [in LXX: [[Sir.32.21|Sir.32:21]], [[3Ma.3.8|3Ma.3:8]] * ;]
1. act., **not causing to stumble**: metaphorically, of not leading others into sin, [[1Co.10.32|1Co.10:32]]
2. Pass., **not stumbling, without offence, blameless**: [[Act.24.16|Act.24:16]], [[Php.1.10|Php.1:10]] (for exx., see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0641.def:
**ἀπο-ρίπτω**
(Rec. -ρρίπτω, c1.), [in LXX for שָׁלַךְ hi., etc. ;]
**to throw away, cast forth**: reflexively, [[Act.27.43|Act.27:43]] (BV, cast themselves overboard; see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0675.def:
**Ἀππιος**, -ου, ὁ
**Appius**; Ἀππίου Φόρον, Appii Forum (Market of Appius), **a town in Italy**: [[Act.28.15|Act.28:15]]†
(AS)

G0685.def:
**ἀρά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אָלָה ];
1. a prayer (MM, see word).
2. (as in Homer) a curse, **malediction**: [[Rom.3.14|Rom.3:14]] (LXX),†
(AS)

G0603.def:
**ἀπο-καραδοκία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἀποκαραδοκέω, used by Aq. in [[Psa.37.7|Psa.37:7]] for חוּל; ἀπό, κάρα the head, δοκέω, in Ion., to watch),
to watch with outstretched head, watch anxiously (Polyb., π.; see Deiss., _LAE_, 374.5, 377 f.), [[Rom.8.19|Rom.8:19]], [[Php.1.20|Php.1:20]] (Lft., in l; Cremer, 177).†
(AS)

G0662.def:
**ἀπο-τολμάω**, -ῶ
**to be quite bold, make a bold venture**: [[Rom.10.20|Rom.10:20]]†
(AS)

G0663.def:
**ἀποτομία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἀποτέμνω, **to cut of**), [in Sm.: [[Jer.51.35|Jer.51:35]], [[Nam.3.1|Nam.3:1]] * ;]
**steepness, sharpness**; metaphorically, **severity** (MM, see word): [[Rom.11.22|Rom.11:22]]†
(AS)

G0610.def:
**ἀπό-κριμα**, -τος, τό
(ἀποκρίνω);
1. prop., **a judicial sentence**: [[2Co.1.9|2Co.1:9]], R, mg.
2. **an answer **(see Thayer, see word): [[2Co.1.9|2Co.1:9]], R, txt. (In FlJ, _Ant._, xiv, 10, 6, of a rescript of the Senate; in Inscr. of an official decision, Deiss., BS, 257; a reply to a deputation, MM, see word: cf. also Cremer, 3'75).†
(AS)

G0664.def:
**ἀποτόμως **
_adv._, [in LXX: [[Wis.5.22|Wis.5:22]] * ;]
**abruptly, curtly, hence sharply, severely**: [[2Co.13.10|2Co.13:10]], [[Tit.1.13|Tit.1:13]] (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0604.def:
**ἀπο-κατ-αλλάσσω**
(cf. καταλλάσσω: ἀπό here signifies completely, see Lft., Col., l.with; Ellic., _Eph._, l.with; but also Mey., _Eph._, l.with),
**to reconcile completely**: [[Eph.2.16|Eph.2:16]], [[Col.1.20-21|Col.1:20-21]].†
(AS)

G0699.def:
**ἀρεσκία** (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ
(ἀρέσκω), [in LXX (-εία): [[Pro.31.30|Pro.31:30]] (חֵן) * ;]
**pleasing, desire to please**: [[Col.1.19|Col.1:19]] In Gk. writers (Arist., Polyb.), most frequently in bad sense, but in π., Inscr., and in Philo, as above (see Deiss., BS, 224; MM, see word; Cremer, 642).†
(AS)

G0671.def:
**ἀπό-χρησις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποχράομαι, to use to the full, abuse)
**abuse, misuse**: [[Col.2.22|Col.2:22]] (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0642.def:
**ἀπ-ορφανίζω**
(ἀπό, ὀρφανός),
**to be bereaved **(prop., of a parent, Lft., _Notes_, 36); metaphorically, [[1Th.2.17|1Th.2:17]] (where Field thinks it = χωρισθέντες, _Notes_, 199).†
(AS)

G0619.def:
**ἀπόλαυσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπολαύω, to take of, enjoy a thing) [in LXX: [[3Ma.7.16|3Ma.7:16]] * ;]
**enjoyment**: [[1Ti.6.17|1Ti.6:17]], [[Heb.11.26|Heb.11:26]] (for late exx., see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0665.def:
**ἀπο-τρέπω **
[in LXX: [[Sir.20.29; 48.18|Sir.20:29 48:18]], [[3Ma.1.23|3Ma.1:23]], [[4Ma.1.33|4Ma.1:33]] [[4Mac.16.12|4Mac 16:12]] * ;]
**to turn away**; mid., **to turn oneself away from**: with accusative, [[2Ti.3.5|2Ti.3:5]]†
(AS)

G0661.def:
**ἀπο-τίνω (or -τίω) **
[in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם pi. ;]
**to pay off, repay**: Phm 19 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0616.def:
**ἀπο-κυέω**
(Rec. -κύω), -ῶ (ἀπό, κυέω or κύω, to be pregnant), [in LXX: [[4Ma.15.17|4Ma.15:17]] * ;]
prop., "the medical word for birth as the close of pregnancy" (Hort, _Ja._, 26 f.). In κοιν, "an ordinary syn. of τίκτω, but definitely 'perfectivised' (M, _Pr._, 111 ff.; MM, see word) by the
ἀπό, and so implying **safe delivery," to bring forth, give birth to**: [[Jas.1.15, 18|Jas.1:15, 18]].†
(AS)

G0644.def:
**ἀπο-σκίασμα**, -τος, τό
(ἀποσκιάζω, to cast a shadow; v,s. σκία)
**a shadow**: [[Jas.1.17|Jas.1:17]] (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0678.def:
**ἀπροσωπολήμπτως** (Rec. -λήπτως, cl.), adv.
(α- neg., προσωπολήμπτης),
**without respect of persons, impartially**: [[1Pe.1.17|1Pe.1:17]]†
(AS)

G0632.def:
**ἀπο-νέμω**
(νέμω, to distribute), [in LXX: [[Deu.4.19|Deu.4:19]] (חָלַק), [[3Ma.1.7|3Ma.1:7]] [[3Mac.3.16|3Mac 3:16]] * ;]
**to assign, apportion**: [[1Pe.3.7|1Pe.3:7]] (In π. of a Prefect who renders to all their dues; see MM, see word)†
(AS)

G0668.def:
**ἀπο-φεύγω **
[in LXX: [[Sir.22.22|Sir.22:22]] * ;]
**to flee from, escape**: with accusative, [[2Pe.2.18; 2.20|2Pe.2:18 2:20]]; with genitive, [[2Pe.1.4|2Pe.1:4]]†
(AS)

G0691.def:
**ἀργέω**, -ῶ
(ἀργός), [in LXX: [[Est.4.24|Est.4:24]], [[Ecc.12.3|Ecc.12:3]] (בָּטֵל), I [[Est.2.30|Est.2:30]], [[Sir.33.27|Sir.33:27]]), [[2Ma.5.25|2Ma.5:25]] * ;]
**to be idle**; τὸ κρίμα . . . ἀ., lingers (cf. M_Gr._ ἀργά, **late**: MM, see word): [[2Pe.2.3|2Pe.2:3]]†
(AS)

G0679.def:
**ἄ-πταιστος**, -ον
(πταίω), [in LXX: [[3Ma.6.39|3Ma.6:39]] * ;]
**without stumbling, sure-footed**: metaphorically (MM, see word), [[Jude.24|Ju 24]].†
(AS)

G0623.def:
**Ἀπολλύων**, -οντος, ὁ
(present ptcp. of ἀπολλύω),
Apollyon, i.e. the Destroyer: [[Rev.9.11|Rev.9:11]] (cf. Ἀβάδδων). (Cremer, 453; _DB_, i, 125, 172.) †
(AS)
